intent: Presentational bar-waveform SVG that stands in as the visual for an audio asset, drawing deterministic bars from a seed or from explicit peaks.

tokens.color: note: no token bound in source — bars are fill="currentColor"; callers set the color via a text-* utility on a parent
tokens.layout: size-full (stretches the svg to fill its container)
tokens.geometry: note: hardcoded plain SVG math, not tokens — viewBox 0 0 100 100, preserveAspectRatio="none", default bars=40, gap 0.35 of a slot, bar rx = barWidth/2, min bar height 2

a11y.role: none — presentational <svg>, aria-hidden by default (aria-hidden prop defaults true)
a11y.labeling: carries no accessible name, title, or role; decorative. The containing asset thumbnail/row must convey that it represents audio.
a11y.note: bars are visual only; even with aria-hidden={false} the svg still exposes no label or role.
